fixed: An incoming tag, author or custom field whose name is already taken by a different record is now reported instead of being quietly stored under the wrong name or merged into the record you had deleted.

changed: Give every syncable kind a writeFromSync entry point and route the inbound apply through it, per §6.7's rule that an apply never travels the interactive upsert path. The sync writer does not adopt a tombstoned row's identity, does not substitute the local natural key, and does not seed existence_at — it refuses the record and lets the engine report it.
Add the sync-interactive-upsert ratchet so an inbound write cannot drift back onto the editor's path.
